constraints: All elements in nums are unique.
problem.explanation: We use backtracking to generate subsets. We maintain a current path of numbers. At each index, we add the current path to the results. Then we iterate through the remaining elements, appending each to the path, recursing, and then popping the element to backtrack. Finally, we sort the sublists and then the outer list for deterministic output.
hints: Use a backtracking approach to build the subsets.
At each step, you can either include the current element in the subset or exclude it.
problem.statement_markdown:
Given an integer array `nums` of unique elements, return all possible subsets (the power set).

The solution set must not contain duplicate subsets. For determinism in testing, return the subsets as a sorted list of sorted sublists. The empty list should appear first.
problem.title: Generate all subsets
